DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図の印の場所は見つかりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you find the location marked on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも花がありません。印の下を少し掘れば、植えた球根が見えるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 観察地図の印を植えた位置と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but there are no flowers. If I dig a little below the mark, will I see the bulbs that were planted?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the mark on the observation map for the planting location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 掘らないでください。この印は、先月花を観察した場所で、植えた位置の案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not dig. This mark shows where flowers were observed last month; it does not indicate where they were planted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなのですね。今日も同じ花があると思っていました。何も見えない場合も記録してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日花が見つからない状態も記録できるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I thought the same flowers would still be here today. May I also record it if I cannot see any?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can record that you cannot find flowers today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。今日見えた状態を記録してください。先月の写真を見て、今日もあったことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please record what you can see today. Do not look at last month's photo and record the flowers as also being present today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日は花が見つからないと書き、葉の写真だけ撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在見えた葉だけを記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will write that I could not find any flowers today and take a photo of just the leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will record only the leaves you can currently see. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 葉を取らずに、周囲の景色も含めて撮ると位置を照合しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you photograph the surrounding scenery as well, without picking the leaves, it will be easier to match the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。持ち帰らず、地図の番号と写真を対応させます。名前が分からない葉は断定せず書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 植物を取らず番号と写真を対応させ未確認の名前を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will leave them here and match the map numbers to the photos. I will not state a definite name for leaves I cannot identify.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not pick the plants; match the numbers to the photos and avoid stating unconfirmed names as facts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録をまとめたら、観察会のテーブルで担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have put your records together, a staff member will check them at the observation group's table.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日の観察と先月の記録を分け、植物を動かさず記録を提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今の観察と過去の記録を分けて提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will keep today's observations separate from last month's records and submit my records without moving the plants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will submit your current observations separately from past records. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認用のテーブルはこちらです。記録ができましたらお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12227-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The table for checking records is over here. Please bring yours when they are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お乗りになる予定の列車は、いま発車しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has the train you planned to take just departed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同行者はまだ駅に着いていません。私だけ次の列車へ乗るか、一緒に待つか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予定の列車が発車し同行者が未到着だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My companion has not reached the station yet. I am unsure whether to take the next train on my own or wait so we can travel together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your planned train has departed and your companion has not arrived. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 目的地での集合時刻と、同行者の到着見込みは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the meeting time at your destination and when your companion expects to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 目的地で二時です。同行者はあと十分で着くそうです。二人で使う荷物を私が持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 集合時刻と同行者の到着見込みと共同の荷物を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: We are meeting at our destination at two. My companion says they will be here in ten minutes. I have the luggage that we both need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the meeting time, your companion's expected arrival time, and explain about the shared luggage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、次の列車の時刻と到着見込みを確認しましょう。別々に乗るなら荷物の受け渡しも相談が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check the next train's departure time and expected arrival time. If you travel separately, you will also need to discuss handing over the luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。間に合うなら二人で次に乗り、難しければ目的地の相手に遅れると伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着見込みに応じ一緒に乗るか連絡するか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If we can arrive in time, we will both take the next train. If that is difficult, I would like to tell the person at our destination that we will be late.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss whether to travel together or contact the person, depending on the expected arrival time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の発車時刻はこちらです。途中の移動時間も含めて集合時刻を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the next departure time. Please check whether you can make the meeting time, including the travel time along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先に乗ったことにせず、いまは駅で待っていると同行者へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在駅で待っていると同行者へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will tell my companion I am currently waiting at the station, rather than making it sound as if I have already boarded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your companion that you are currently waiting at the station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お待ち合わせは、改札外の案内板の前をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I can direct you to the information board outside the ticket gates as a meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。次の列車と到着見込みを二人で確認し、案内板の前で合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流場所と次の列車を共有すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We will both check the next train and expected arrival time and meet in front of the information board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will share the meeting place and information about the next train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内板はこちらです。発車案内も併せてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The information board is here. Please also check the departure information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請用の写真はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought the photograph for your application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この台紙に四枚あります。ここで一枚切ればよいですか。切る線が二種類あって迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の切取り線が二種類あると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There are four on this sheet. Should I cut one out here? There are two kinds of cutting lines, so I am not sure which to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that there are two kinds of cutting lines for the photographs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の申請に必要な寸法を案内で確認しましょう。まだ切らずに見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the instructions for the dimensions required for this application. Please show me the sheet without cutting it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。小さい方で切ると、顔の上が少し欠けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切り方で顔が欠ける可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. If I cut along the smaller line, it looks as though a little of the top of my face will be cut off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the way you cut it could crop part of your face. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 寸法だけでなく顔の範囲も確認します。この写真はいつ撮影しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check not only the dimensions but also how much of your face is included. When was this photograph taken?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先月です。台紙の大きい線で切れば使えるか、先に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影時期と大きい線で使えるかを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Last month. I would like to check first whether I can use it if I cut along the larger line on the sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the date the photograph was taken and check whether cutting along the larger line will make it usable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が申請条件と写真を照合します。使えると確認できたら必要な一枚を切りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will compare the photograph with the application requirements. Once we confirm that it can be used, let us cut out the one you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。四枚とも同じ寸法に切ってしまわず、今回使う一枚だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件確認後に必要な一枚だけ切ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not cut all four to the same size; I will cut only the one I need for this application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will cut out only the one necessary photograph after confirming the requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切った後は表面を傷つけず、指定の位置へ貼る前に向きも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: After cutting it, avoid scratching the surface and check its orientation before attaching it in the designated place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。必要な寸法と顔の範囲を確認し、切った一枚の向きを見てから貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寸法と顔の範囲と貼付方向を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will check the required dimensions and how much of my face must be included, then check the orientation of the cut photograph before attaching it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the dimensions, the area of the face to include, and the orientation for attaching the photograph. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真の条件はこちらです。担当者と台紙を見ながら確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the photograph requirements. Let us check them with the staff member while looking at your sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付は済んでいます。診察までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have completed check-in. Please wait until your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で頼んだ通訳が、十二時までしかいられません。受付を訳してもらったので、診察もすぐ始まると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通訳の滞在期限と受付後の誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The interpreter I arranged myself can only stay until twelve. Since they interpreted the check-in for me, I thought my consultation would start right away too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the interpreter's time limit and your misunderstanding after check-in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付の完了と診察の開始は別です。順番を確認しますが、開始時刻は確約できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Completing check-in and starting the consultation are separate matters. I will check the queue, but I cannot guarantee a start time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。通訳が帰る前に、診察に間に合う見込みだけでも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察開始の見込みを期限と合わせて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Before the interpreter leaves, I would at least like to find out whether they are likely to be here in time for the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Discuss the expected consultation start time together with the interpreter's time limit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者へ相談します。間に合わない場合に通訳の時間を延ばせるか、ご自身でも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will consult the staff member. Please also check for yourself whether the interpreter can extend their time if the consultation will not start in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。勝手に延長できると思わず、通訳本人に確認します。難しければ別の方法も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通訳に延長可否を確認し代替方法も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will ask the interpreter directly rather than assuming they can stay longer. If that is difficult, I would like to discuss other options too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the interpreter can stay longer and discuss alternative options as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通訳が同席できない場合の説明方法や、別日の相談可否を診療担当者と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check with the clinical staff how explanations could be given if the interpreter cannot be present, and whether arranging another day is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。受付だけを訳してもらったことを、診察の説明まで理解したことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付の通訳と診察説明の理解を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will not treat having the check-in interpreted as meaning that I have also understood the explanations during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish between interpretation at check-in and understanding the consultation explanations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点を担当者へ伝えます。いまの受付は、相談が決まるまでそのまま扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain that to the staff member. Your current check-in will remain as it is until we decide how to proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。通訳の終了時刻を伝え、診察の対応方法が決まるまで帰らず相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付を自己取消せず対応方法が決まるまで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will explain when the interpreter has to finish and stay to discuss things until we have decided how to handle the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not cancel your check-in yourself and will wait until the arrangements are decided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 診療担当者に連絡します。通訳の方とこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will contact the clinical staff. Please wait here with your interpreter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この方は、出来事を一緒に見た方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this someone who witnessed the incident with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。後で交番への道を聞いた人です。助けてもらったので、関係した人の欄へ名前を書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記入した人は道を教えただけだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. This is someone I later asked for directions to the police box. They helped me, so I wrote their name in the section for people involved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the person you listed only gave you directions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その方が出来事を目撃したかどうかは、確認できていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you have not confirmed whether that person witnessed the incident, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私が説明した話を聞いただけです。現場にいたとは言われていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: その人の目撃は確認していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. They only heard my account of what happened. They did not say they were at the scene.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not confirmed whether that person witnessed the incident. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 直接目撃した方と、後からお話を聞いた方を分けて記録しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us record people who witnessed it directly separately from those who only heard about it afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。その人を目撃者として扱わず、道を教わった経緯だけを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目撃者と後から話を聞いた人を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not treat that person as a witness; I will only explain how they gave me directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish between an eyewitness and someone who heard the story afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名前や連絡先は、どのように知りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: How did you find out their name and contact information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名札で名前を見ただけです。連絡先は聞いていません。本人が連絡を希望したとも言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名前を知った経緯と連絡先の未取得を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only saw their name on a name badge. I did not ask for their contact information. I also cannot say that they wanted to be contacted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you learned the person's name and that you have not obtained their contact information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報の範囲も確認します。欄の訂正方法は担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also clarify the limits of that information. The staff member will explain how to correct the section.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。私自身が見たことを中心に書き、道を教わったことは別に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の目撃と道案内の経緯を別に記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will focus on what I saw myself and explain separately how I was given directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record what you witnessed yourself separately from how you received directions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのように区別して担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass the information on to the staff member with that distinction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱を発送されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ship this box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ出さないでください。三つの商品をまとめましたが、一つだけ別の人へ送ることになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付前に一つの商品だけ送り先が変わったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please do not send it yet. I packed three items together, but now one of them needs to go to a different person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the recipient of just one item changed before the parcel was accepted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付前ですので、内容を分けてから改めてお持ちください。どの商品を取り出すか確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so please separate the contents and bring them back. Have you confirmed which item to take out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青いケースの商品です。ただ、同じ形の白いケースもあるので、品名まで確認して取り出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 色だけでなく品名を見て取り出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The item in the blue case. There is also a white case of the same shape, though, so I will check the product name before taking it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the product name as well as the color before taking the item out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 開けた後は、残る二つが箱の中で動かないよう梱包を調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: After opening the box, please adjust the packing so that the two remaining items will not move inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。一つ抜くだけで閉じず、空いた部分も整えます。取り出した商品は別の箱に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残りの箱の空間を調整し別箱を用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not just remove one and close the box; I will also fill the empty space properly. I will put the item I remove into another box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Adjust the empty space in the original box and prepare a separate box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送り先のラベルもそれぞれ確認してください。元の箱は元の宛先のままでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check each address label too. Is the original box still going to the original address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。二つは元の宛先、一つは新しい宛先です。品名と相手をメモにして照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 商品とそれぞれの送り先を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Two items will go to the original address, and one will go to the new address. I will write down the product names and recipients and cross-check them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match each item to its respective recipient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備後は、それぞれの重さや大きさで発送方法と料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After you have finished preparing them, we will check the shipping methods and charges based on the weight and size of each parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。元の料金を二つの箱に分けると思わず、梱包後に別々に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 梱包後の各箱で料金と発送方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not assume that the original charge will simply be split between the two boxes. I will check each one separately after packing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the charge and shipping method for each box after packing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 梱包が整いましたら、二つの荷物として受付をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: When the packing is ready, we will help you send them as two separate parcels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座の解約をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to close your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。もう使わないつもりですが、店からの返金が来週この口座へ入る予定でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 解約希望の口座に返金予定があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I do not intend to use it anymore, but a refund from a shop was scheduled to come into this account next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a refund is expected in the account you wish to close. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返金は、まだ受け取っていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not received the refund yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。店にはこの番号を伝えたままです。今日閉じてから、返金先を変えればよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返金先は未変更でまだ入金がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. The shop still has this account number. I am unsure whether I can close the account today and then change where the refund is sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not changed the refund destination and the money has not arrived yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返金先の変更が間に合うかは、店への確認が必要です。解約を先に進めず、受取予定を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to check with the shop whether there is still time to change the refund destination. Let us confirm the expected payment before proceeding with closing the account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。店へ変更できるか聞き、できなければ返金を確認してから解約を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店に変更可否を確認し結果で解約時期を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will ask the shop whether it can be changed. If it cannot, I will discuss closing the account after confirming receipt of the refund.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the shop whether the refund destination can be changed, then decide when to close the account based on the answer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに入金や引き落としの予定がないか、ご自身の記録もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check your own records for any other expected deposits or scheduled debits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。最近の取引と予定を見直します。残高が少ないだけで、予定が全部終わったとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残高だけでなく他の入出金予定も見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will review my recent transactions and upcoming payments. I will not assume that everything scheduled has finished just because the balance is low.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Review other expected deposits and withdrawals as well as the balance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な確認が済んでから、解約の手続きをご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can guide you through closing the account once you have completed the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は解約を進めず、返金先と残っている予定を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前に解約を進めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not proceed with closing it today. I will check the refund destination and any remaining scheduled transactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not proceed with closing the account before checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認後のご相談をお待ちします。手続きの案内はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come back to discuss it after checking. Here is the information about the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お取り置き商品の受け取りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to collect an item we put aside for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、売場で別の種類を見つけたので、こちらに変えたいです。元の一箱も残ったままでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 取り置きと別の商品へ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. However, I found a different type on the sales floor and would like to switch to this one. Is the original box still being held for me too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to change from the reserved item to a different product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お取り置きの内容を確認します。お名前と商品を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check your reservation. Please tell me your name and the product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエンです。朝に小さい缶の一箱を頼みました。今は大きい缶を六本買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名と元の商品変更後の数量を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: My name is Nguyen. This morning I asked you to hold one box of small cans. Now I would like to buy six large cans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your name, the original product, and the quantity you want after the change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の取り置きを解除できるか担当者に確認します。変更先は一箱ではなく六本ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the staff member whether we can cancel the original reservation. You want six individual cans, rather than one box, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。両方を買う予定ではありません。元の分をそのまま会計に加えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二重購入しないよう元の分の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I do not intend to buy both. Please do not add the original item to my purchase as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check what will happen to the original item so that you do not buy it twice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更が確認できるまでは、お取り置き分はこちらで管理します。六本の在庫も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will keep the reserved item here until the change is confirmed. I will also check whether we have six cans in stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。六本がそろわなければ、勝手に元の箱へ戻すのでなく、選び直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望数量がない場合は選び直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. If six are not available, I would like to choose again rather than having you automatically switch me back to the original box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to choose again if the quantity you want is unavailable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認しました。元の取り置きは解除し、大きい缶は六本ご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have checked. We can cancel the original reservation and provide six large cans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。小さい缶の箱は受け取らず、大きい缶六本だけの会計でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 解除された元の商品と買う六本を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will not take the box of small cans. Please charge me for just the six large cans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish between the original item whose reservation was canceled and the six cans you are buying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。変更後の商品と数量で会計いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will charge you for the revised product and quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そちらの落ち葉は、まだ袋へ入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please do not put those fallen leaves into a bag yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 清掃の残りだと思いました。別の場所の落ち葉と一緒に集めてよいか聞こうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落ち葉の山を清掃の残りと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought they were left over from the cleaning. I was about to ask whether I could collect them together with leaves from elsewhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the pile of leaves was left over from the cleaning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この教材の活動では、虫の観察に使うため、一か所に残した落ち葉です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In the activity in this learning material, these leaves have been left in one place to use for observing insects.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなのですね。私が集めてよい範囲は、どこで分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 集めてよい範囲の確認方法を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. How can I find out which area I am allowed to collect leaves from?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to check the area where you may collect leaves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図で通路の清掃範囲を示しています。観察用の場所は範囲から外しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The guide map shows the area of the path to be cleaned. The observation area is excluded from that area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。見た目で全部を片付けず、通路の範囲を確認して集めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 観察用の場所を避けて指定範囲で作業すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will not clear everything just based on how it looks. I will check the designated area of the path before collecting leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will avoid the observation area and work within the designated area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: すでに観察用の山から取った葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you already taken any leaves from the observation pile?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手前の一握りを袋に入れました。ほかのごみはまだ入っていないので、その分を確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: すでに取った量と袋の内容を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put a handful from the front into the bag. There is no other rubbish in it yet. Could you check those leaves for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how much you have already taken and what is in the bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋の中を担当者が確認します。ご自身で戻す前に、そのままお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: A staff member will check the contents of the bag. Please hand it over as it is before putting anything back yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。集めた分を見てもらい、次は案内図の範囲で作業します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己判断で戻さず確認後に作業すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will have someone check what I collected, then work within the area shown on the guide map next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not put the leaves back at your own discretion and will work after they have been checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋の確認は担当者が行います。こちらの案内図で清掃範囲をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12228-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will check the bag. Please check the cleaning area on this guide map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのバスをご利用ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 西口から出ると聞きました。西口という名前のバスならよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出口名をバス名と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told it leaves from the west exit. Should I take any bus called West Exit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the exit name for the name of the bus. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 西口は駅の出口です。行き先はどちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The west exit is an exit from the station. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 市民会館です。出口名をバスの行き先だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本来の目的地を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The civic hall. I thought the exit name was the bus destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your actual destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 出口の外に複数の乗場があります。市民会館へ行く路線を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are several bus stops outside the exit. Let us check which route goes to the civic hall.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。乗場の番号と、バスの前に出る表示を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗場番号と車両の表示を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I would like to know the stop number and what will be displayed on the front of the bus.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the stop number and the display on the bus. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この教材では二番乗場の市民会館行きです。発車時刻はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: In this learning material, it is the bus bound for the civic hall from stop two. Here is the departure time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二番ですね。別の行き先のバスが来ても、そのまま乗らず確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の行き先の車両へ乗らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Stop two, right. Even if a bus for another destination arrives, I will check rather than just getting on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not board a bus for a different destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗車時に行き先を運転手にも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also confirm the destination with the driver when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。西口から二番乗場へ行き、市民会館行きか確かめて乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出口と乗場と行き先を区別して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will go from the west exit to stop two and check that the bus is bound for the civic hall before getting on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish between the exit, stop, and destination and check them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 西口は左側です。乗場案内もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12229-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The west exit is on the left. Please also check the guide to the bus stops.
